sources.source_yaml:
name: Clued Cloud production release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: >-
          Release mode. Only deploy and migrate change production, and both first consume
          an Owner Grant for this commit. preflight runs the read-only gate, backup creates
          the encrypted pre-migration backup, source-capture captures one reviewed storage
          client source, migrate applies the named migration files. deploy publishes the
          PDF, main application and Kooyumi Connect Workers as one controlled release.
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: preflight
        options:
          - preflight
          - backup
          - source-capture
          - deploy
          - migrate
      source_request_id:
        description: Exact approved authorization request UUID; source-capture mode only
        type: string
        default: ''
      source_request_digest:
        description: Exact immutable authorization request SHA-256; source-capture mode only
        type: string
        default: ''
      migrations:
        description: >-
          migrate mode only: migration file names under apps/clued-cloud/supabase/migrations,
          comma-separated, in the order to apply
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: clued-cloud-production-release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  release:
    if: >-
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      github.actor == github.repository_owner &&
      github.triggering_actor == github.repository_owner
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    # OwnerCredential §6.1: CLUED_RELEASE_TOKEN and CLUED_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL
    # live in this environment (Owner setting: deployment branches main only).
    environment: clued-release
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/clued-cloud
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: apps/clued-cloud/package-lock.json
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Validate exclusive release mode
        env:
          RELEASE_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
          SOURCE_REQUEST_ID: ${{ inputs.source_request_id }}
          SOURCE_REQUEST_DIGEST: ${{ inputs.source_request_digest }}
          MIGRATIONS: ${{ inputs.migrations }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Deploy is never implied: an unknown or missing mode stops here, before any
          # production credential is read.
          case "$RELEASE_MODE" in
            preflight|backup|deploy)
              test -z "$SOURCE_REQUEST_ID"
              test -z "$SOURCE_REQUEST_DIGEST"
              test -z "${MIGRATIONS:-}" ;;
            source-capture)
              test -n "$SOURCE_REQUEST_ID"
              test -n "$SOURCE_REQUEST_DIGEST"
              test -z "${MIGRATIONS:-}" ;;
            migrate)
              test -z "$SOURCE_REQUEST_ID"
              test -z "$SOURCE_REQUEST_DIGEST"
              test -n "${MIGRATIONS:-}" ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::Unknown release mode '$RELEASE_MODE'" >&2
              exit 1 ;;
          esac
          echo "Release mode: $RELEASE_MODE"
      - name: Check production database credential
        if: ${{ inputs.mode != 'source-capture' }}
        env:
          CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL_V2 }}
        run: |
          test -n "$CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL"
      - name: Check least-privilege source credentials
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'source-capture' }}
        env:
          CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.CLUED_STORAGE_SOURCE_DATABASE_URL }}
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_STORAGE_SOURCE_CLOUDFLARE_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ vars.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        run: |
          test -n "$CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL"
          test -n "$CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
          test -n "$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID"
      - name: Check production backup encryption credential
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'backup' }}
        env:
          CLUED_PRODUCTION_BACKUP_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLUED_PRODUCTION_BACKUP_KEY }}
        run: test -n "$CLUED_PRODUCTION_BACKUP_KEY"
      # The connection URLs are written for node-postgres, whose sslmode=no-verify
      # (encrypt, do not verify the certificate) libpq rejects; libpq's require
      # means the same, so the libpq tools below get require instead.
      - name: Create and verify encrypted pre-migration backup
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'backup' }}
        env:
          CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL_V2 }}
          CLUED_PRODUCTION_BACKUP_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLUED_PRODUCTION_BACKUP_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence_dir=.sites-runtime/release-evidence
          mkdir -p "$evidence_dir"
          umask 077
          backup_tmp=$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-production-backup-XXXXXX")
          dump_path="$backup_tmp/clued-production-pre-migration.dump"
          encrypted_path="$evidence_dir/clued-production-pre-migration.dump.enc"
          verified_path="$backup_tmp/clued-production-pre-migration.dump.verified"
          scope_proof="$backup_tmp/scope-proof.json"
          backup_container="clued-production-backup-$(basename "$backup_tmp")"
          cleanup_plaintext() {
            original_status=$?
            cleanup_status=0
            # Stop the only container that can write the allocated scratch
            # before removing plaintext, including on cancellation/failure.
            # Discover by the allocated scratch ownership label even when a
            # cancellation arrives before docker run returns its receipt.
            container_id=$(docker container ls --all --quiet \
              --filter "name=^/${backup_container}$" \
              --filter "label=clued.backup-scratch=$backup_tmp") || cleanup_status=1
            if [ -n "$container_id" ]; then
              docker rm -f "$backup_container" >/dev/null || cleanup_status=1
            fi
            if [ "$cleanup_status" -ne 0 ]; then
              echo "::error::Could not prove this job's backup producer stopped; plaintext cleanup cannot be verified" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            for plaintext in "$dump_path" "$verified_path" "$scope_proof"; do
              if [ -f "$plaintext" ]; then
                shred -u -- "$plaintext" || cleanup_status=1
              fi
            done
            rmdir -- "$backup_tmp" || cleanup_status=1
            if [ "$cleanup_status" -ne 0 ]; then
              echo "::error::Could not remove this job's plaintext backup files" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            exit "$original_status"
          }
          trap cleanup_plaintext EXIT
          trap 'exit 130' INT
          trap 'exit 143' TERM
          database_url=$(node -e 'const url = new URL(process.env.CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL); url.searchParams.delete("uselibpqcompat"); if (url.searchParams.get("sslmode") === "no-verify") url.searchParams.set("sslmode", "require"); process.stdout.write(url.toString())')
          docker run --rm -d --name "$backup_container" \
            --label "clued.backup-scratch=$backup_tmp" \
            --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
            -e DATABASE_URL="$database_url" \
            -v "$backup_tmp:/backup" \
            postgres@sha256:00bc86618629af00d2937fdc5a5d63db3ff8450acf52f0636ec813c7f4902929 \
            sh -ceu 'sleep 3600' >/dev/null
          # One consistent archive: pg_dump -t would override all -n selectors.
          # The publisher first refuses any migration-schema object beyond the
          # history table and its necessary dependencies, then verifies actual
          # table/data/routine catalog coverage against the same exported snapshot.
          node scripts/verify-production-backup-scope.mjs "$backup_container" "$backup_tmp"
          dump_sha256=$(sha256sum "$dump_path" | cut -d' ' -f1)
          dump_bytes=$(wc -c < "$dump_path" | tr -d ' ')
          openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 200000 -salt \
            -in "$dump_path" -out "$encrypted_path" \
            -pass env:CLUED_PRODUCTION_BACKUP_KEY
          openssl enc -d -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 200000 \
            -in "$encrypted_path" -out "$verified_path" \
            -pass env:CLUED_PRODUCTION_BACKUP_KEY
          test "$(sha256sum "$verified_path" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$dump_sha256"
          encrypted_sha256=$(sha256sum "$encrypted_path" | cut -d' ' -f1)
          node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"); const proof=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8")); if(proof.verified!==true) throw new Error("Unverified backup scope"); process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({contract:"clued.production-pre-migration-backup.v1",source_commit:process.env.GITHUB_SHA,database_project:"clued-prod",scope:proof.scope,scope_verification:proof,dump_sha256:process.argv[2],dump_bytes:Number(process.argv[3]),encrypted_sha256:process.argv[4],created_at:new Date().toISOString()},null,2)+"\n")' \
            "$scope_proof" "$dump_sha256" "$dump_bytes" "$encrypted_sha256" \
            > "$evidence_dir/production-backup-manifest.json"
      # It connects once (select 1), so a wrong password or host fails here,
      # before the grant step uses one of the Owner's grants (trial run
      # 37155374056 used its grant and then failed to authenticate).
      - name: Check migration database credential
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'migrate' }}
        env:
          CLUED_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.CLUED_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$CLUED_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL"
          # A malformed URL (for example an unencoded @ or # in the password)
          # is reported without echoing the value.
          database_url=$(node -e 'let url; try { url = new URL(process.env.CLUED_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL) } catch { console.error("::error::CLUED_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL is not a valid URL; URL-encode special characters in the password"); process.exit(1) } url.searchParams.delete("uselibpqcompat"); if (url.searchParams.get("sslmode") === "no-verify") url.searchParams.set("sslmode", "require"); process.stdout.write(url.toString())')
          connected=$(docker run --rm -i --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" postgres:17-alpine \
            psql "$database_url" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -X -tA -c 'select 1') \
            || { echo "::error::Cannot connect with CLUED_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL; no grant was used"; exit 1; }
          [ "$connected" = "1" ] || { echo "::error::Unexpected answer from the migration database; no grant was used"; exit 1; }
          echo "Migration database connection works"
      # OwnerCredential §6.1 (Task 2a31ca2a): before anything changes production,
      # consume one use of the Owner's grant for the named migration files of
      # this commit. Advisory until the Owner sets CLUED_RELEASE_GRANT_ENFORCE=true;
      # then no grant, no run. It runs after the credential check, so a run that
      # cannot proceed uses no grant. deploy consumes its grant further down,
      # after the release gate.
      - name: Consume the Owner Grant for the named migrations
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'migrate' }}
        working-directory: .
        env:
          RELEASE_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
          MIGRATIONS: ${{ inputs.migrations }}
          CLUED_RELEASE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_RELEASE_TOKEN }}
          CLUED_CONFIRM_ORIGIN: https://kooyumi.pixelgrav.com
          CLUED_RELEASE_GRANT_ENFORCE: ${{ vars.CLUED_RELEASE_GRANT_ENFORCE }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-release-grant.mjs --mode "$RELEASE_MODE"
      # OwnerCredential §6.1: each named file from this commit is applied in its
      # own transaction together with its schema_migrations row (statements =
      # the file's exact text), then md5(statements) is checked against the file.
      # A file whose name is already recorded is refused, never re-applied.
      # The file reaches the server as COPY data on psql's standard input, which
      # psql never reads as meta-commands (\! would run a shell next to the
      # credential, re-review N6), and which has no size limit (a psql -c
      # argument holds at most 128 KiB). The server rebuilds the text and checks
      # its md5 against the file before it runs it. The text runs through plpgsql
      # EXECUTE, so a file may not hold transaction control (begin, commit,
      # savepoint, rollback) or end with SELECT ... INTO; either fails and rolls
      # back, leaving no record.
      - name: Apply the named migrations
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'migrate' }}
        env:
          CLUED_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.CLUED_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL }}
          MIGRATIONS: ${{ inputs.migrations }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence_dir=.sites-runtime/release-evidence
          mkdir -p "$evidence_dir"
          database_url=$(node -e 'const url = new URL(process.env.CLUED_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL); url.searchParams.delete("uselibpqcompat"); if (url.searchParams.get("sslmode") === "no-verify") url.searchParams.set("sslmode", "require"); process.stdout.write(url.toString())')
          psql() { docker run --rm -i --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e DATABASE_URL="$database_url" \
            -v "$PWD:/work:ro" -w /work postgres:17-alpine psql "$database_url" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -X "$@"; }
          applied='[]'
          for name in $(printf '%s' "$MIGRATIONS" | tr ',' ' '); do
            [[ "$name" =~ ^[0-9]{14}_[a-z0-9_]+\.sql$ ]] || { echo "::error::Not a migration file name: $name"; exit 1; }
            file="supabase/migrations/$name"
            test -f "$file" || { echo "::error::$file is not in this commit"; exit 1; }
            short="${name#*_}"; short="${short%.sql}"
            recorded=$(psql -tA -c "select count(*) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations where name='$short'")
            [ "$recorded" = "0" ] || { echo "::error::$short is already recorded in production; not re-applied"; exit 1; }
            # COPY reads one line per row: the file must end with a newline and hold
            # no carriage return, no \x01 or \x02 (the CSV delimiter and quote) and
            # no line that is only \. (the end of COPY data).
            [ -s "$file" ] || { echo "::error::$name is empty"; exit 1; }
            [ -z "$(tail -c1 "$file")" ] || { echo "::error::$name does not end with a newline"; exit 1; }
            if LC_ALL=C grep -q $'[\r\x01\x02]' "$file" || grep -qx '\\\.' "$file"; then
              echo "::error::$name holds a carriage return, \\x01, \\x02 or a line that is only \\."; exit 1
            fi
            expected=$(md5sum "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
            [[ "$expected" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{32}$ ]] || { echo "::error::no md5 for $name"; exit 1; }
            version=$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)
            psql -q -v VERBOSITY=terse \
              -c "create temp table migration_lines(n bigserial primary key, line text)" \
              -c "copy migration_lines(line) from stdin with (format csv, delimiter e'\x01', quote e'\x02')" \
              -c "begin;
          do \$apply\$ declare s text := (select string_agg(coalesce(line, ''), e'\n' order by n) from migration_lines) || e'\n';
          begin
            if md5(s) is distinct from '$expected' then raise exception 'migration text differs from the file'; end if;
            execute s;
            -- Scheduler readiness is an activation dependency of storage I9.
            -- Check inside this same transaction, before the migration ledger
            -- can record success. Earlier schemas have no such dependency.
            if to_regprocedure('clued_private.storage_conflict_require_scheduler_v1()') is not null then
              perform clued_private.storage_conflict_require_scheduler_v1();
            end if;
            insert into supabase_migrations.schema_migrations(version, name, statements) values ('$version', '$short', array[s]);
          end \$apply\$;
          commit;" < "$file"
            stored=$(psql -tA -c "select md5(array_to_string(statements,'')) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations where version='$version' and name='$short'")
            [ "$stored" = "$expected" ] || { echo "::error::$short md5 $stored differs from the file $expected"; exit 1; }
            echo "Applied $short as $version (md5 $expected)"
            applied=$(node -e 'const a=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);a.push({file:process.argv[2],name:process.argv[3],version:process.argv[4],md5:process.argv[5]});process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(a))' "$applied" "$name" "$short" "$version" "$expected")
            sleep 1
          done
          node -e 'process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({contract:"clued.production-migration-apply.v1",source_commit:process.env.GITHUB_SHA,applied:JSON.parse(process.argv[1]),finished_at:new Date().toISOString()},null,2)+"\n")' "$applied" \
            > "$evidence_dir/production-migrations.json"
      - if: ${{ inputs.mode != 'backup' && inputs.mode != 'migrate' }}
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Capture exact nonsecret registration source
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'source-capture' }}
        env:
          CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.CLUED_STORAGE_SOURCE_DATABASE_URL }}
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_STORAGE_SOURCE_CLOUDFLARE_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ vars.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          REQUEST_ID: ${{ inputs.source_request_id }}
          REQUEST_DIGEST: ${{ inputs.source_request_digest }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p .sites-runtime/storage-client-source
          node scripts/storage-client-registration-source.mjs \
            --request-id "$REQUEST_ID" \
            --expected-request-digest "$REQUEST_DIGEST" \
            --expected-release-sha "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --output .sites-runtime/storage-client-source/registration.json
      - name: Install embedded PostgreSQL ICU compatibility runtime
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'preflight' || inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          icu_deb=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-libicu60-XXXXXX.deb")
          trap 'rm -f -- "$icu_deb"' EXIT
          curl -fsSLo "$icu_deb" https://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/pool/main/i/icu/libicu60_60.2-3ubuntu3.2_amd64.deb
          sudo dpkg -i "$icu_deb"
      - name: Verify projection and MTPE behavior
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'preflight' || inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        run: |
          node --test tests/production-release-gate.test.mjs tests/served-agent-contract.test.mjs
          npm run test:projection:refresh
          npm run test:mtpe:intake
          npm run typecheck
      - name: Build exact Worker source
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'preflight' || inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        # Builds the main Worker and the PDF extractor Worker (dist/pdf-extractor),
        # and fails if the main Worker's bundle contains pdf.js.
        run: npm run build
      - name: Verify and build Kooyumi Connect release source
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'preflight' || inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --test tests/oauth-origin.test.mjs
          node --check ../kooyumi-connect/worker.mjs
          node --test ../kooyumi-connect/tests/*.test.mjs
          mkdir -p .sites-runtime/release-evidence
          node ../kooyumi-connect/build-release.mjs \
            --out-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/kooyumi-connect-build" \
            --evidence-out .sites-runtime/release-evidence/connect-build.json
          node --check "$RUNNER_TEMP/kooyumi-connect-build/worker.mjs"
      - name: Block release unless database and Worker heartbeat are ready
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'preflight' || inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        env:
          CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL_V2 }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p .sites-runtime/release-evidence
          node scripts/production-release-gate.mjs --pre-deploy \
            --evidence-out .sites-runtime/release-evidence/production-preflight.json
      - name: Check Cloudflare deployment credential
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_TOKEN_V2 }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ vars.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        run: |
          test -n "$CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
          test -n "$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID"
      # OwnerCredential §6.1: consume one use of the Owner's grant for this
      # commit before anything changes production. It runs after the release
      # gate and the credential checks, so a deploy the gate stops uses no grant
      # (run 37329072487 used its grant and then stopped at the gate).
      - name: Consume the Owner Grant for this commit
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        working-directory: .
        env:
          # Steps before this one ran dependency code (npm ci, tests, build);
          # none of it may preload code into the grant check.
          NODE_OPTIONS: ''
          RELEASE_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
          CLUED_RELEASE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_RELEASE_TOKEN }}
          CLUED_CONFIRM_ORIGIN: https://kooyumi.pixelgrav.com
          CLUED_RELEASE_GRANT_ENFORCE: ${{ vars.CLUED_RELEASE_GRANT_ENFORCE }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-release-grant.mjs --mode "$RELEASE_MODE"
      - name: Ensure Storage job queue exists
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_TOKEN_V2 }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ vars.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The Worker's producer and consumer bindings need the queue before deploy.
          if ! npx wrangler queues info clued-storage-jobs >/dev/null; then
            npx wrangler queues create clued-storage-jobs
          fi
      - name: Deploy Clued PDF extractor Worker
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_TOKEN_V2 }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ vars.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        # StorageNormalUse §4.5 (Owner decision 7210e5a5): clued-storage-pdf parses
        # PDFs in its own isolate. It has no bindings, vars or secrets and no public
        # route, and is deployed first because the main Worker's PDF_EXTRACTOR
        # service binding names it.
        run: npx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.pdf-extractor.jsonc
      - name: Deploy Clued production Worker
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        env:
          CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL_V2 }}
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_TOKEN_V2 }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ vars.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        run: npx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc --keep-vars
      - name: Record deployment completion time
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        id: deployment_completion
        run: echo "timestamp=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3NZ)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Verify exact live commit and currentness transport
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        env:
          CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL_V2 }}
        run: node scripts/verify-currentness-transport.mjs --production --evidence-out .sites-runtime/release-evidence/currentness-attestation.json
      - name: Verify production serves the repository Agent contract
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        run: node scripts/verify-served-agent-contract.mjs --evidence-out .sites-runtime/release-evidence/served-agent-contract.json
      - name: Verify the PDF extractor service binding
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        run: node scripts/verify-pdf-extractor.mjs --evidence-out .sites-runtime/release-evidence/pdf-extractor.json
      # The existing service binding already names clued-cloud. Publish Connect only
      # after the main application's exact commit, contract and PDF binding pass.
      # The same commit's Owner Grant above covers this explicit release cohort.
      - name: Deploy Kooyumi Connect Worker
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_TOKEN_V2 }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ vars.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        run: >-
          npx wrangler deploy "$RUNNER_TEMP/kooyumi-connect-build/worker.mjs"
          --config ../kooyumi-connect/wrangler.production.jsonc --no-bundle --keep-vars
      - name: Verify Kooyumi Connect production release
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        run: node ../kooyumi-connect/verify-production.mjs --evidence-out .sites-runtime/release-evidence/connect-postflight.json
      - name: Verify projection currentness after deployment
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        env:
          CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL_V2 }}
        run: |
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
            if node scripts/production-release-gate.mjs --pre-deploy \
              --min-heartbeat-at '${{ steps.deployment_completion.outputs.timestamp }}' \
              --evidence-out .sites-runtime/release-evidence/production-postflight.json; then
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 30
          done
          exit 1
      - name: Preserve release evidence
        if: always()

            [ "$recorded" = "0" ] || { echo "::error::$short is already recorded in production; not re-applied"; exit 1; }
            # COPY reads one line per row: the file must end with a newline and hold
            # no carriage return, no \x01 or \x02 (the CSV delimiter and quote) and
            # no line that is only \. (the end of COPY data).
            [ -s "$file" ] || { echo "::error::$name is empty"; exit 1; }
            [ -z "$(tail -c1 "$file")" ] || { echo "::error::$name does not end with a newline"; exit 1; }
            if LC_ALL=C grep -q $'[\r\x01\x02]' "$file" || grep -qx '\\\.' "$file"; then
              echo "::error::$name holds a carriage return, \\x01, \\x02 or a line that is only \\."; exit 1
            fi
            expected=$(md5sum "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
            [[ "$expected" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{32}$ ]] || { echo "::error::no md5 for $name"; exit 1; }
            version=$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)
            psql -q -v VERBOSITY=terse \
              -c "create temp table migration_lines(n bigserial primary key, line text)" \
              -c "copy migration_lines(line) from stdin with (format csv, delimiter e'\x01', quote e'\x02')" \
              -c "begin;
          do \$apply\$ declare s text := (select string_agg(coalesce(line, ''), e'\n' order by n) from migration_lines) || e'\n';
          begin
            if md5(s) is distinct from '$expected' then raise exception 'migration text differs from the file'; end if;
            execute s;
            -- Scheduler readiness is an activation dependency of storage I9.
            -- Check inside this same transaction, before the migration ledger
            -- can record success. Earlier schemas have no such dependency.
            if to_regprocedure('clued_private.storage_conflict_require_scheduler_v1()') is not null then
              perform clued_private.storage_conflict_require_scheduler_v1();
            end if;
            insert into supabase_migrations.schema_migrations(version, name, statements) values ('$version', '$short', array[s]);
          end \$apply\$;
          commit;" < "$file"
            stored=$(psql -tA -c "select md5(array_to_string(statements,'')) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations where version='$version' and name='$short'")
            [ "$stored" = "$expected" ] || { echo "::error::$short md5 $stored differs from the file $expected"; exit 1; }
            echo "Applied $short as $version (md5 $expected)"
            applied=$(node -e 'const a=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);a.push({file:process.argv[2],name:process.argv[3],version:process.argv[4],md5:process.argv[5]});process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(a))' "$applied" "$name" "$short" "$version" "$expected")
            sleep 1
          done
          node -e 'process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({contract:"clued.production-migration-apply.v1",source_commit:process.env.GITHUB_SHA,applied:JSON.parse(process.argv[1]),finished_at:new Date().toISOString()},null,2)+"\n")' "$applied" \
            > "$evidence_dir/production-migrations.json"
      - if: ${{ inputs.mode != 'backup' && inputs.mode != 'migrate' }}
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Capture exact nonsecret registration source
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'source-capture' }}
        env:
          CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.CLUED_STORAGE_SOURCE_DATABASE_URL }}
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_STORAGE_SOURCE_CLOUDFLARE_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ vars.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          REQUEST_ID: ${{ inputs.source_request_id }}
          REQUEST_DIGEST: ${{ inputs.source_request_digest }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p .sites-runtime/storage-client-source
          node scripts/storage-client-registration-source.mjs \
            --request-id "$REQUEST_ID" \
            --expected-request-digest "$REQUEST_DIGEST" \
            --expected-release-sha "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --output .sites-runtime/storage-client-source/registration.json
      - name: Install embedded PostgreSQL ICU compatibility runtime
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'preflight' || inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          icu_deb=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-libicu60-XXXXXX.deb")
          trap 'rm -f -- "$icu_deb"' EXIT
          curl -fsSLo "$icu_deb" https://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/pool/main/i/icu/libicu60_60.2-3ubuntu3.2_amd64.deb
          sudo dpkg -i "$icu_deb"
      - name: Verify projection and MTPE behavior
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'preflight' || inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        run: |
          node --test tests/production-release-gate.test.mjs tests/served-agent-contract.test.mjs
          npm run test:projection:refresh
          npm run test:mtpe:intake
          npm run typecheck
      - name: Build exact Worker source
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'preflight' || inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        # Builds the main Worker and the PDF extractor Worker (dist/pdf-extractor),
        # and fails if the main Worker's bundle contains pdf.js.
        run: npm run build
      - name: Verify and build Kooyumi Connect release source
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'preflight' || inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --test tests/oauth-origin.test.mjs
          node --check ../kooyumi-connect/worker.mjs
          node --test ../kooyumi-connect/tests/*.test.mjs
          mkdir -p .sites-runtime/release-evidence
          node ../kooyumi-connect/build-release.mjs \
            --out-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/kooyumi-connect-build" \
            --evidence-out .sites-runtime/release-evidence/connect-build.json
          node --check "$RUNNER_TEMP/kooyumi-connect-build/worker.mjs"
      - name: Block release unless database and Worker heartbeat are ready
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'preflight' || inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        env:
          CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL_V2 }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p .sites-runtime/release-evidence
          node scripts/production-release-gate.mjs --pre-deploy \
            --evidence-out .sites-runtime/release-evidence/production-preflight.json
      - name: Check Cloudflare deployment credential
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_TOKEN_V2 }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ vars.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        run: |
          test -n "$CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
          test -n "$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID"
      # OwnerCredential §6.1: consume one use of the Owner's grant for this
      # commit before anything changes production. It runs after the release
      # gate and the credential checks, so a deploy the gate stops uses no grant
      # (run 37329072487 used its grant and then stopped at the gate).
      - name: Consume the Owner Grant for this commit
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        working-directory: .
        env:
          # Steps before this one ran dependency code (npm ci, tests, build);
          # none of it may preload code into the grant check.
          NODE_OPTIONS: ''
          RELEASE_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
          CLUED_RELEASE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_RELEASE_TOKEN }}
          CLUED_CONFIRM_ORIGIN: https://kooyumi.pixelgrav.com
          CLUED_RELEASE_GRANT_ENFORCE: ${{ vars.CLUED_RELEASE_GRANT_ENFORCE }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-release-grant.mjs --mode "$RELEASE_MODE"
      - name: Ensure Storage job queue exists
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_TOKEN_V2 }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ vars.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The Worker's producer and consumer bindings need the queue before deploy.
          if ! npx wrangler queues info clued-storage-jobs >/dev/null; then
            npx wrangler queues create clued-storage-jobs
          fi
      - name: Deploy Clued PDF extractor Worker
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_TOKEN_V2 }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ vars.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        # StorageNormalUse §4.5 (Owner decision 7210e5a5): clued-storage-pdf parses
        # PDFs in its own isolate. It has no bindings, vars or secrets and no public
        # route, and is deployed first because the main Worker's PDF_EXTRACTOR
        # service binding names it.
        run: npx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.pdf-extractor.jsonc
      - name: Deploy Clued production Worker
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        env:
          CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL_V2 }}
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_TOKEN_V2 }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ vars.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        run: npx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc --keep-vars
      - name: Record deployment completion time
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        id: deployment_completion
        run: echo "timestamp=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3NZ)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Verify exact live commit and currentness transport
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        env:
          CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL_V2 }}
        run: node scripts/verify-currentness-transport.mjs --production --evidence-out .sites-runtime/release-evidence/currentness-attestation.json
      - name: Verify production serves the repository Agent contract
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        run: node scripts/verify-served-agent-contract.mjs --evidence-out .sites-runtime/release-evidence/served-agent-contract.json
      - name: Verify the PDF extractor service binding
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        run: node scripts/verify-pdf-extractor.mjs --evidence-out .sites-runtime/release-evidence/pdf-extractor.json
      # The existing service binding already names clued-cloud. Publish Connect only
      # after the main application's exact commit, contract and PDF binding pass.
      # The same commit's Owner Grant above covers this explicit release cohort.
      - name: Deploy Kooyumi Connect Worker
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_TOKEN_V2 }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ vars.CLUED_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        run: >-
          npx wrangler deploy "$RUNNER_TEMP/kooyumi-connect-build/worker.mjs"
          --config ../kooyumi-connect/wrangler.production.jsonc --no-bundle --keep-vars
      - name: Verify Kooyumi Connect production release
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        run: node ../kooyumi-connect/verify-production.mjs --evidence-out .sites-runtime/release-evidence/connect-postflight.json
      - name: Verify projection currentness after deployment
        if: ${{ inputs.mode == 'deploy' }}
        env:
          CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL_V2 }}
        run: |
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
            if node scripts/production-release-gate.mjs --pre-deploy \
              --min-heartbeat-at '${{ steps.deployment_completion.outputs.timestamp }}' \
              --evidence-out .sites-runtime/release-evidence/production-postflight.json; then
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 30
          done
          exit 1
      - name: Preserve release evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: clued-cloud-production-release-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            apps/clued-cloud/.sites-runtime/release-evidence/production-preflight.json
            apps/clued-cloud/.sites-runtime/release-evidence/currentness-attestation.json
            apps/clued-cloud/.sites-runtime/release-evidence/served-agent-contract.json
            apps/clued-cloud/.sites-runtime/release-evidence/pdf-extractor.json
            apps/clued-cloud/.sites-runtime/release-evidence/connect-build.json
            apps/clued-cloud/.sites-runtime/release-evidence/connect-postflight.json
            apps/clued-cloud/.sites-runtime/release-evidence/production-postflight.json
            apps/clued-cloud/.sites-runtime/release-evidence/clued-production-pre-migration.dump.enc
            apps/clued-cloud/.sites-runtime/release-evidence/production-backup-manifest.json
            apps/clued-cloud/.sites-runtime/release-evidence/production-migrations.json
            apps/clued-cloud/.sites-runtime/storage-client-source/registration.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: ${{ inputs.mode == 'source-capture' && 1 || 30 }}

mode.description: Release mode. Only deploy and migrate change production, and both first consume an Owner Grant for this commit. preflight runs the read-only gate, backup creates the encrypted pre-migration backup, source-capture captures one reviewed storage client source, migrate applies the named migration files. deploy publishes the PDF, main application and Kooyumi Connect Workers as one controlled release.

steps.name: Validate exclusive release mode
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Deploy is never implied: an unknown or missing mode stops here, before any
# production credential is read.
case "$RELEASE_MODE" in
  preflight|backup|deploy)
    test -z "$SOURCE_REQUEST_ID"
    test -z "$SOURCE_REQUEST_DIGEST"
    test -z "${MIGRATIONS:-}" ;;
  source-capture)
    test -n "$SOURCE_REQUEST_ID"
    test -n "$SOURCE_REQUEST_DIGEST"
    test -z "${MIGRATIONS:-}" ;;
  migrate)
    test -z "$SOURCE_REQUEST_ID"
    test -z "$SOURCE_REQUEST_DIGEST"
    test -n "${MIGRATIONS:-}" ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::Unknown release mode '$RELEASE_MODE'" >&2
    exit 1 ;;
esac
echo "Release mode: $RELEASE_MODE"

steps.name: Create and verify encrypted pre-migration backup
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
evidence_dir=.sites-runtime/release-evidence
mkdir -p "$evidence_dir"
umask 077
backup_tmp=$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-production-backup-XXXXXX")
dump_path="$backup_tmp/clued-production-pre-migration.dump"
encrypted_path="$evidence_dir/clued-production-pre-migration.dump.enc"
verified_path="$backup_tmp/clued-production-pre-migration.dump.verified"
scope_proof="$backup_tmp/scope-proof.json"
backup_container="clued-production-backup-$(basename "$backup_tmp")"
cleanup_plaintext() {
  original_status=$?
  cleanup_status=0
  # Stop the only container that can write the allocated scratch
  # before removing plaintext, including on cancellation/failure.
  # Discover by the allocated scratch ownership label even when a
  # cancellation arrives before docker run returns its receipt.
  container_id=$(docker container ls --all --quiet \
    --filter "name=^/${backup_container}$" \
    --filter "label=clued.backup-scratch=$backup_tmp") || cleanup_status=1
  if [ -n "$container_id" ]; then
    docker rm -f "$backup_container" >/dev/null || cleanup_status=1
  fi
  if [ "$cleanup_status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "::error::Could not prove this job's backup producer stopped; plaintext cleanup cannot be verified" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  for plaintext in "$dump_path" "$verified_path" "$scope_proof"; do
    if [ -f "$plaintext" ]; then
      shred -u -- "$plaintext" || cleanup_status=1
    fi
  done
  rmdir -- "$backup_tmp" || cleanup_status=1
  if [ "$cleanup_status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "::error::Could not remove this job's plaintext backup files" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  exit "$original_status"
}
trap cleanup_plaintext EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM
database_url=$(node -e 'const url = new URL(process.env.CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL); url.searchParams.delete("uselibpqcompat"); if (url.searchParams.get("sslmode") === "no-verify") url.searchParams.set("sslmode", "require"); process.stdout.write(url.toString())')
docker run --rm -d --name "$backup_container" \
  --label "clued.backup-scratch=$backup_tmp" \
  --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
  -e DATABASE_URL="$database_url" \
  -v "$backup_tmp:/backup" \
  postgres@sha256:00bc86618629af00d2937fdc5a5d63db3ff8450acf52f0636ec813c7f4902929 \
  sh -ceu 'sleep 3600' >/dev/null
# One consistent archive: pg_dump -t would override all -n selectors.
# The publisher first refuses any migration-schema object beyond the
# history table and its necessary dependencies, then verifies actual
# table/data/routine catalog coverage against the same exported snapshot.
node scripts/verify-production-backup-scope.mjs "$backup_container" "$backup_tmp"
dump_sha256=$(sha256sum "$dump_path" | cut -d' ' -f1)
dump_bytes=$(wc -c < "$dump_path" | tr -d ' ')
openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 200000 -salt \
  -in "$dump_path" -out "$encrypted_path" \
  -pass env:CLUED_PRODUCTION_BACKUP_KEY
openssl enc -d -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 200000 \
  -in "$encrypted_path" -out "$verified_path" \
  -pass env:CLUED_PRODUCTION_BACKUP_KEY
test "$(sha256sum "$verified_path" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$dump_sha256"
encrypted_sha256=$(sha256sum "$encrypted_path" | cut -d' ' -f1)
node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"); const proof=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8")); if(proof.verified!==true) throw new Error("Unverified backup scope"); process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({contract:"clued.production-pre-migration-backup.v1",source_commit:process.env.GITHUB_SHA,database_project:"clued-prod",scope:proof.scope,scope_verification:proof,dump_sha256:process.argv[2],dump_bytes:Number(process.argv[3]),encrypted_sha256:process.argv[4],created_at:new Date().toISOString()},null,2)+"\n")' \
  "$scope_proof" "$dump_sha256" "$dump_bytes" "$encrypted_sha256" \
  > "$evidence_dir/production-backup-manifest.json"

steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
test -n "$CLUED_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL"
# A malformed URL (for example an unencoded @ or # in the password)

connected=$(docker run --rm -i --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" postgres:17-alpine \

sources.source_yaml:
name: Clued Cloud production release
run-name: ${{ inputs.fleet_release_run != '' && format('fleet-release-{0}-{1}', inputs.mode, inputs.fleet_release_run) || 'Clued Cloud production release' }}

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: >-
          Release mode. deploy, migrate and release each first consume an Owner Grant for
          this commit. preflight runs the read-only gate, backup
          creates the encrypted pre-migration backup, source-capture captures one reviewed
          storage client source, migrate applies the named migration files. deploy publishes
          the PDF, main application and Kooyumi Connect Workers as one controlled release.
          release is the same deploy from one approval for a commit whose every change a
          Worker version rollback undoes: it takes no migrations (apply them with migrate
          first) and runs only when the three wrangler production configurations are byte for
          byte those of the commit the edge serves (otherwise use deploy). deploy and release
          roll the Workers back to the versions they served if a deploy or verification fails.
          fleet-accept checks the universal node package fleet-node-<fleet_version>.
          It opens one Owner request, reads the private delivery projection, or confirms
          the Release's attached acceptance file. The Owner approves on the confirmation page.
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: preflight
        options:
          - preflight
          - backup
          - source-capture
          - deploy
          - migrate
          - release
          - fleet-accept
      source_request_id:
        description: Exact approved authorization request UUID; source-capture mode only
        type: string
        default: ''
      source_request_digest:
        description: Exact immutable authorization request SHA-256; source-capture mode only
        type: string
        default: ''
      migrations:
        description: >-
          migrate mode only: migration file names under apps/clued-cloud/supabase/migrations,
          comma-separated, in the order to apply
        type: string
        default: ''
      expected_release_sha:
        description: Exact main SHA for fleet migration reconciliation and apply
        type: string
        default: ''
      fleet_release_run:
        description: Fleet prepare operation ID for preflight or migrate
        type: string
        default: ''
      fleet_version:
        description: >-
          fleet-accept mode only: the version of the published universal node package
          (Release tag fleet-node-<version>)
        type: string
        default: ''
      fleet_request_sha256:
        description: >-
          fleet-accept mode only: SHA-256 of that Release's
          fleet-node-<version>.acceptance-request.json, 64 lowercase hex characters
        type: string
        default: ''
      fleet_operation:
        description: fleet-accept operation (empty/open, project or confirm)
        type: string
        default: ''
      fleet_delivery_key:
        description: Ephemeral X25519 reply key for project and confirm
        type: string
        default: ''
      fleet_acceptance_sha256:
        description: SHA-256 of the already attached acceptance file (confirm)
        type: string
        default: ''
      rollback_drill:
        description: >-
          release mode only: after every verification has passed, fail on purpose before
          the G6 attestation is written, so the Workers roll back through the real path
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read
  checks: read
  pull-requests: read

# Fleet delivery has its own group so it does not queue behind a Worker release.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ inputs.mode == 'fleet-accept' && 'clued-cloud-fleet-accept' || (inputs.mode == 'preflight' && inputs.fleet_release_run != '') && 'clued-cloud-fleet-migration-read' || 'clued-cloud-production-release' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  release:
    if: >-
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      github.actor == github.repository_owner &&
      github.triggering_actor == github.repository_owner
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # deploy and release: at least every step plus the rollback (each has its
    # own timeout-minutes; tests/production-release-gate.test.mjs checks the sum).
    # Every other mode keeps 45: the migrate steps have no step timeout, and a
    # stalled migration must not hold the concurrency group longer than before.
    # Fleet confirmation includes replay setup, the replay, and all shared steps.

mode.description: Release mode. deploy, migrate and release each first consume an Owner Grant for this commit. preflight runs the read-only gate, backup creates the encrypted pre-migration backup, source-capture captures one reviewed storage client source, migrate applies the named migration files. deploy publishes the PDF, main application and Kooyumi Connect Workers as one controlled release. release is the same deploy from one approval for a commit whose every change a Worker version rollback undoes: it takes no migrations (apply them with migrate first) and runs only when the three wrangler production configurations are byte for byte those of the commit the edge serves (otherwise use deploy). deploy and release roll the Workers back to the versions they served if a deploy or verification fails. fleet-accept checks the universal node package fleet-node-<fleet_version>. It opens one Owner request, reads the private delivery projection, or confirms the Release's attached acceptance file. The Owner approves on the confirmation page.

source_request_id.description: Exact approved authorization request UUID; source-capture mode only

source_request_digest.description: Exact immutable authorization request SHA-256; source-capture mode only

migrations.description: migrate mode only: migration file names under apps/clued-cloud/supabase/migrations, comma-separated, in the order to apply

expected_release_sha.description: Exact main SHA for fleet migration reconciliation and apply

fleet_release_run.description: Fleet prepare operation ID for preflight or migrate

fleet_version.description: fleet-accept mode only: the version of the published universal node package (Release tag fleet-node-<version>)

fleet_request_sha256.description: fleet-accept mode only: SHA-256 of that Release's fleet-node-<version>.acceptance-request.json, 64 lowercase hex characters

fleet_delivery_key.description: Ephemeral X25519 reply key for project and confirm

fleet_acceptance_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the already attached acceptance file (confirm)

rollback_drill.description: release mode only: after every verification has passed, fail on purpose before the G6 attestation is written, so the Workers roll back through the real path

steps.name: Validate exclusive release mode
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Deploy is never implied: an unknown or missing mode stops here, before any
# production credential is read.
case "$RELEASE_MODE" in
  preflight|backup|deploy)
    test -z "$SOURCE_REQUEST_ID"
    test -z "$SOURCE_REQUEST_DIGEST"
    test -z "${MIGRATIONS:-}" ;;
  source-capture)
    test -n "$SOURCE_REQUEST_ID"
    test -n "$SOURCE_REQUEST_DIGEST"
    test -z "${MIGRATIONS:-}" ;;
  migrate)
    test -z "$SOURCE_REQUEST_ID"
    test -z "$SOURCE_REQUEST_DIGEST"
    test -n "${MIGRATIONS:-}" ;;
  release)
    test -z "$SOURCE_REQUEST_ID"
    test -z "$SOURCE_REQUEST_DIGEST"
    # A release carries only what a Worker version rollback undoes; a
    # migration cannot be rolled back with the Workers.
    if [ -n "${MIGRATIONS:-}" ]; then
      echo "::error::release takes no migrations: apply them with migrate mode first, then release" >&2
      exit 1
    fi ;;
  fleet-accept)
    test -z "$SOURCE_REQUEST_ID"
    test -z "$SOURCE_REQUEST_DIGEST"
    test -z "${MIGRATIONS:-}"
    # The two values are checked here as fixed shapes and travel on as
    # environment values only, never as shell or SQL text.
    if ! [[ "${FLEET_VERSION:-}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._+-]{0,88}$ ]]; then
      echo "::error::fleet_version is not a universal node package version" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    if ! [[ "${FLEET_REQUEST_SHA256:-}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
      echo "::error::fleet_request_sha256 is not 64 lowercase hex characters" >&2
      exit 1
    fi ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::Unknown release mode '$RELEASE_MODE'" >&2
    exit 1 ;;
esac
if [ "$RELEASE_MODE" != "fleet-accept" ] && [ -n "${FLEET_VERSION:-}${FLEET_REQUEST_SHA256:-}${FLEET_OPERATION:-}${FLEET_DELIVERY_KEY:-}${FLEET_ACCEPTANCE_SHA256:-}" ]; then
  echo "::error::fleet_* inputs require fleet-accept mode" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ -n "${FLEET_RELEASE_RUN:-}${EXPECTED_RELEASE_SHA:-}" ]; then
  [[ "$RELEASE_MODE" = preflight || "$RELEASE_MODE" = migrate ]]
  [[ "$FLEET_RELEASE_RUN" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{8}(-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$ ]]
  [[ "$EXPECTED_RELEASE_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ && "$EXPECTED_RELEASE_SHA" = "$GITHUB_SHA" ]]
  test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_RELEASE_SHA"
fi
if [ "${ROLLBACK_DRILL:-false}" != "false" ] && [ "$RELEASE_MODE" != "release" ]; then
  echo "::error::rollback_drill is a release-mode switch" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "Release mode: $RELEASE_MODE"

steps.name: Create and verify encrypted pre-migration backup
steps.run:

encrypted_path="$evidence_dir/clued-production-pre-migration.dump.enc"

scope_proof="$backup_tmp/scope-proof.json"
backup_container="clued-production-backup-$(basename "$backup_tmp")"
cleanup_plaintext() {
  original_status=$?
  cleanup_status=0
  # Stop the only container that can write the allocated scratch
  # before removing plaintext, including on cancellation/failure.
  # Discover by the allocated scratch ownership label even when a
  # cancellation arrives before docker run returns its receipt.
  container_id=$(docker container ls --all --quiet \
    --filter "name=^/${backup_container}$" \
    --filter "label=clued.backup-scratch=$backup_tmp") || cleanup_status=1
  if [ -n "$container_id" ]; then
    docker rm -f "$backup_container" >/dev/null || cleanup_status=1
  fi
  if [ "$cleanup_status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "::error::Could not prove this job's backup producer stopped; plaintext cleanup cannot be verified" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  for plaintext in "$dump_path" "$verified_path" "$scope_proof"; do
    if [ -f "$plaintext" ]; then
      shred -u -- "$plaintext" || cleanup_status=1
    fi
  done
  rmdir -- "$backup_tmp" || cleanup_status=1
  if [ "$cleanup_status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "::error::Could not remove this job's plaintext backup files" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  exit "$original_status"
}
trap cleanup_plaintext EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM
database_url=$(node -e 'const url = new URL(process.env.CLUED_ATTESTATION_DATABASE_URL); url.searchParams.delete("uselibpqcompat"); if (url.searchParams.get("sslmode") === "no-verify") url.searchParams.set("sslmode", "require"); process.stdout.write(url.toString())')
docker run --rm -d --name "$backup_container" \
  --label "clued.backup-scratch=$backup_tmp" \
  --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
  -e DATABASE_URL="$database_url" \
  -v "$backup_tmp:/backup" \
  postgres@sha256:00bc86618629af00d2937fdc5a5d63db3ff8450acf52f0636ec813c7f4902929 \
  sh -ceu 'sleep 3600' >/dev/null
# One consistent archive: pg_dump -t would override all -n selectors.
# The publisher first refuses any migration-schema object beyond the
# history table and its necessary dependencies, then verifies actual
# table/data/routine catalog coverage against the same exported snapshot.
node scripts/verify-production-backup-scope.mjs "$backup_container" "$backup_tmp"
dump_sha256=$(sha256sum "$dump_path" | cut -d' ' -f1)
dump_bytes=$(wc -c < "$dump_path" | tr -d ' ')
openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 200000 -salt \
  -in "$dump_path" -out "$encrypted_path" \
  -pass env:CLUED_PRODUCTION_BACKUP_KEY
openssl enc -d -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 200000 \
  -in "$encrypted_path" -out "$verified_path" \
  -pass env:CLUED_PRODUCTION_BACKUP_KEY
test "$(sha256sum "$verified_path" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$dump_sha256"

  "$scope_proof" "$dump_sha256" "$dump_bytes" "$encrypted_sha256" \
  > "$evidence_dir/production-backup-manifest.json"
